title: TIMES-ADAPT: A Quantum algorithm for real-time evolution in low-energy subspaces using fixed-depth circuits
summary: We propose a new variational quantum algorithm, which we refer to as TIMES-ADAPT, that prepares time-evolved states in a low-energy or symmetric subspace of a time-independent Hamiltonian on a quantum computer. Using a specially trained unitary that diagonalizes the Hamiltonian in a subspace, we construct fixed-depth circuits for real-time evolution in the subspace, where time only enters as a circuit parameter.
